result:
Everything is clean: 617/617 tests pass, typecheck and lint are clean, and my own sanity checks confirmed all five reported scenarios now behave per ADR 0003. Summary of the fix:

- **`src/server/repositories/user-repository.ts`**: `findUserByEmail`/`insertUser` now lowercase the address themselves, so case can never fork an account into two rows regardless of caller.
- **`src/server/services/organization-service.ts`**: `createOrganization` now runs `uniqueSlug()` (which already skips reserved words and suffixes collisions) *before* `assertValidSlug`, instead of gate-checking the raw candidate first — so a name like "Admin" or "J" lands on "admin-2" instead of being refused.
- **`src/lib/slug.ts`**: `uniqueSlug` now treats a slugified result shorter than `SLUG_MIN_LENGTH` the same as empty, falling back instead of returning a too-short slug.
- **`src/server/services/auth-service.ts`**: `register()` now derives the workspace slug with a `"workspace"` fallback for empty/too-short names, derives the workspace name with truncation so `"<name>'s workspace"` always fits the org name limit, throttles on a new `auth:register` bucket before any writes, and refuses a duplicate address with a new `EmailAlreadyRegisteredError` (`conflict`) instead of a generic `Error`. `login()`/`confirmPasswordReset()` now throw the shared `RateLimitedError` instead of a generic `Error`.
- **`src/lib/rate-limit.ts`** / **`src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts`**: `RateLimitedError` moved to `lib/rate-limit.ts` (re-exported from the actions module for existing callers) so the service layer can throw it too.
- **`src/lib/errors.ts`**: `toAppError`/`isDomainError` now recognize `RateLimitedError` and `EmailAlreadyRegisteredError`, mapping them to `rate_limited` (429) and `conflict` (409) instead of falling through to `internal_error`.
- **`src/schemas/organization.ts`**: exported `ORGANIZATION_NAME_MAX_LENGTH` as the single source of truth, reused by `auth-service.ts`'s truncation logic.
